Theorem
[WMP for weak subsolutions on noncompact manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0178, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0179 1. ch12:12.18\group Weighted Energy Maximum Principles

Let $(M,g)$ be complete. If $u$ is a weak subsolution of $u_t-\Delta u=0$, $u(\cdot ,0)\leq 0$, and for some $\alpha >0$ \[ \int _0^T\! \int _M e^{-\alpha d(x,O)^2}u_+(x,t)^2\, d\mu \, dt<\infty , \] then $u\leq 0$ on $M\times [0,T]$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:evolving-metric-weak-subsolution-wmp Apply Theorem 1.4 to the constant metric family, with $g_*=g$ and $\mathcal H=0$.

□
